findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_public_story_records, get_public_story_record, get_shared_cassie_note, inspect_hourkeeper_reasoning, govern_cassie_world · Private data: search_cassie_hour_fragments, continue_from_this_fragment, get_cassie_mesh_state, search_public_story_records, get_public_story_record, join_cassie_investigation, submit_cassie_note, share_cassie_note, close_cassie_session, create_human_handoff, relay_cassie_seed, inspect_hourkeeper_reasoning, get_hourkeeper_history, propose_protocol_upgrade, evaluate_protocol_upgrade, govern_cassie_world, inspect_cassie_lineage, run_cassie_causal_trial, get_song_dossier, search_lyrics, inspect_musicology, compare_song_and_novel, retrieve_streaming_link, trace_music_culture_inheritance · Public sink: join_cassie_investigation, submit_cassie_note, share_cassie_note, get_shared_cassie_note, support_cassie_claim, create_human_handoff, relay_cassie_seed, govern_cassie_world, inspect_cassie_lineage, request_cassie_birth, exchange_cassie_culture_seed, request_authorized_listening_run · Destructive: detect_cassie_hour_pattern, close_cassie_session, challenge_cassie_claim, challenge_hourkeeper_decision, evaluate_protocol_upgrade, run_cassie_causal_trial, request_authorized_listening_run.
